name: orbiting-circles
title: Orbiting Circles
description: A collection of circles which move in orbit along a circular path.
usage:
import { File, Search, Settings } from "lucide-react" import { OrbitingCircles } from "@/components/ui/orbiting-circles" export function Orbit() { return (
) }

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to every orbiting item (each child is wrapped in its own circle). Other div props (`style`, `data-*`, …) are applied to every item too.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to offset the starting position along the orbit (applied as a negative animation-delay).

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the orbit in pixels.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Size of each orbiting item in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed multiplier (the orbit takes `duration / speed` seconds).

props.name: children
props.description: The items to orbit. They are spread evenly around the circle. Place the component inside a `relative` container that centres its children.
